content: Wi u rɑ ɡerusibu yinɛ, u koo kɑm kowɑ mɑm mɑm subɑru sɔɔ.
Mɑ ɡemɡibɑ dɑbi tem sɔɔ, tɔmbɑ rɑ n nuku dobu mɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so ù n tem kpɑre, tɔmbu kpurowɑ bɑ rɑ n weeweenu mɔ̀.
Bii wi u bwisi kɑsu, u rɑ win tundo nuku dobu wɛ̃wɑ. Wi u rɑ n kurɔ tɑnɔbu ɡɑsirimɔ, u win ɑrumɑni sɑnkumɔwɑ.
Sinɑ boko wi u win tem kpɑre ɡem sɔɔ, u rɑ mu kuurɑsiewɑ. Adɑmɑ wi u nɔm birɑn kɛ̃nu mwɑɑmɔ, u rɑ mu kɑm koosiewɑ.
Wi u win beruse fufu mɔ̀, u nùn yinɑ bɛriɑmmɛwɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ rɑ yinɑ mwɑɑrewɑ ben tiin dɑɑ sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibu bɑ rɑ n nuku dobu yibɑwɑ.
Gemɡii u rɑ n yɛ̃ ye n weenɛ bu sɑ̃ɑrobu kuɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so kun yen bwisi mɔ.
Tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikiobu bɑ rɑ de wuu ɡu burisirɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡibu bɑ rɑ tɔmbun mɔru suresiewɑ.
Bwisiɡii ù n ɡɑri bɔkɔ siribu sokɑ, u yɛ̃ɛwɑ? U mɔru kuɑwɑ? Bɑɑ ǹ n mɛren nɑ, u ǹ bin ɑsɑnsi wɑsi.
Tɔn ɡowobu bɑ ku rɑ ɡemɡii kɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibu bɑ rɑ n kĩwɑ win wɑ̃ɑru tu dɑkɑɑ dɑ.
Gɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ win mɔru tɛriewɑ yɑnde, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡii u rɑ tii nɛnɛwɑ ɡinɑ.
Sinɑ boko ù n dɑ weesu swɑɑ dɑki, win sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ koo kowɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu.
Sɑ̃ɑro kɑ wi u rɑ tɔnu dɑm dɔre, bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ teenu mɔ ni nu ǹ wunɑnɛ. Niyɑ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u ben bɑɑwure yɑm wɑɑsiɑmɔ.
Sinɑ boko wi u rɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ siri dee dee, win bɑndɑ koo dɑkɑɑ dɑ.
Sɛnɑ kɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑbu bu rɑ tɔnu bwisi kɛ̃, ɑdɑmɑ bii wi bɑ mɑɑri u tii kpɑre, win mɛro u koo sekuru wɑ.
Mi tɔn kɔ̃sobɑ dɑbiɑ, miyɑ durum dɑ kpɛ̃yɛ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibu bɑ koo tɔn kɔ̃so ben kɑm kobu wɑ.
A wunɛn bii sɛɛyɑsio kpɑ u nun wɛ̃rɑsiɑ kpɑ ɑ n nuku dobu mɔ.
Tɔmbu bɑ̀ kun Gusunɔn nɔɔ nɔɔmɔ, bɑ rɑ tii yɔ̃suwɑ dɑɑ bɛrɛtɛkɛ sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ doo nɔɔruɡibɑ be bɑ Gusunɔn woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ.
N ǹ kɑ ɡɑri bɑ rɑ yoo sɛɛyɑsie, domi bɑɑ ù n nuɑ, u ǹ yi mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ.
Mɑ tɔnun ɡɑri kun ɑsɑnsi mɔ, ɑ nùn ɡɑrisio ɡɑri bɔkɔ.
Yoo wi bɑ ǹ kɑ bɔɔbɔm kue sɑɑ piiburun di, u rɑ n tɑmɑɑ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ yinnin bii.
Wi u mɔru mɔ, u rɑ sɑnnɔsu seeyewɑ. Mɛyɑ wi u rɑ mɔru se fuuku u ku rɑ torɑnu kpe.
Tii suɑbu bu rɑ tɔnu kɑwewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u tii kɑwe, u rɑ bɛɛrɛ wɑwɑ.
Wi u kɑ ɡbɛnɔ nɔɔ tiɑ sɑ̃ɑ, u tii kɔ̃sɑ kɑsuɑmmɛwɑ, domi u yɛ̃ mɑ bɔ̃ri yi wi sisie. Kɑ mɛ, u yinɑmɔ u ɡem ɡere.
À n tɔnun ɡeren bɛrum mɔ, kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑri bɑkɑ sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ̀ n Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ, u koo nun kɔ̃suwɑ.
Tɔn dɑbirɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ̃ ben yinni u kɑ bu nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛri, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ bɑɑwure wɛ̃ ye n kɑ nùn weenɛ.
Gemɡibu bɑ ku rɑ wee kowobu kɑ̃. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ ku rɑ ɡemɡibu kɑ̃.
Aɡurin ɡɑri
